note: The proportion check's bands (proportions.py, D593): each measure as a share of the body's own height, from ANSUR II (2012), the US Army's survey of 4,082 men, each man's measure over his own stature (research/2026-11-01-why-the-torso-looks-wrong.md). A body fails outside the 1st to 99th percentile of a checked measure. The survey's women are not read yet, so every body is held to the men's shares. Never widen a band to pass a body: fix the body (stretch.py).

reach.what: fingertip to fingertip in the T-pose (span)

fingertip.what: fingertips above the floor, the arm hung straight down from the shoulder joint

wrist.what: wrist joint above the floor, the arm hung straight down from the shoulder joint

crotch.what: the lowest skin on the body's middle line
